Package io.github.lord_of_nothing.select

Class DropDownSelect

java.lang.Object
io.github.lord_of_nothing.select.DropDownSelect
All Implemented Interfaces:
UiElement
Direct Known Subclasses:
GameSpeedSelector, ResolutionSelector
public class DropDownSelect extends Object implements UiElement
Generic dropdown UI element with a header row and optional expanded options list.

    • DropDownSelect

      public DropDownSelect(Map<String,String> options, int selectedIndex, float x, float y, float width, float height, EventBus eventBus)
      Creates a dropdown and optionally registers it as clickable UI.
      Parameters:
      options - label-to-value mapping in display order
      selectedIndex - initially selected row index
      x - dropdown x position
      y - dropdown y position
      width - dropdown width
      height - dropdown header height
      eventBus - event bus used for UI registration
